name: Sommer Trip
source: A short visual novel about a girl named Melody on her graduation trip to Italy. Her friend fell asleep next to her on the bus. In order to fight her boredom, she wants to sit next to one of the tree boys; Lukas, Shane, or Djan.
translation: 这是一部短篇视觉小说，讲述女孩梅洛蒂在毕业旅行中前往意大利的故事。她的朋友在公交车上睡着了。为了打发无聊，她想坐到三个男孩中的一个旁边：卢卡斯、肖恩或詹。
